AlignmentGuardrailsConfig.description: Alignment-layer guardrails from Picard dedup, GC bias, and optional samtools flagstat.

flagstat_enabled.description: When true and BAM present, run samtools flagstat and evaluate pairing guardrails.
flagstat_enabled.title: Flagstat Enabled

max_secondary_supplementary_rate.description: Fail when SECONDARY_OR_SUPPLEMENTARY_RDS / reads_examined exceeds this.
max_secondary_supplementary_rate.title: Max Secondary Supplementary Rate

max_supplementary_rate_flagstat.description: Fail when flagstat supplementary_rate exceeds this.
max_supplementary_rate_flagstat.title: Max Supplementary Rate Flagstat

min_gc_coverage_uniformity.description: When set, fail when min/median NORMALIZED_COVERAGE across GC bins is below this.
min_gc_coverage_uniformity.title: Min Gc Coverage Uniformity

min_mapping_rate.description: Fail when derived mapping_rate from dedup metrics is below this.
min_mapping_rate.title: Min Mapping Rate

min_properly_paired_rate.description: Fail when flagstat properly_paired_rate is below this (linear / Parabricks BAMs). Not applied to methylgrapher_wgbs QC BAMs — surjected Mojo emits historically lack proper-pair bits.
min_properly_paired_rate.title: Min Properly Paired Rate

wgbs_min_mapped_rate.description: Pangenome WGBS (methylGrapher) QC-BAM flagstat mapped-rate floor. C2T-surjected BAMs score much lower than linear Align; leave unset to skip wgbs_bam_mapped_rate (do not reuse min_mapping_rate). Operator-set in site/profile actionConfig.alignment_guardrails.
wgbs_min_mapped_rate.title: Wgbs Min Mapped Rate

AlignmentGuardrailsConfig.title: AlignmentGuardrailsConfig

BisulfiteConversionConfig.description: Quantitative bisulfite conversion QC (sidecar JSON or deamination proxy).

max_deamination_qscore_proxy.description: Unused for voting. Deamination is evaluated only as guardrails.details.deamination_qscore (core_guardrails.max_deamination_qscore). Kept so existing site/profile keys remain valid.
max_deamination_qscore_proxy.title: Max Deamination Qscore Proxy

max_non_cpg_methylation_pct.description: Maximum acceptable non-CpG methylation (%) when sidecar supplies it.
max_non_cpg_methylation_pct.title: Max Non Cpg Methylation Pct

min_conversion_rate_pct.description: Minimum acceptable conversion rate (%) when sidecar supplies it.
min_conversion_rate_pct.title: Min Conversion Rate Pct

sidecar_filename.description: Per-sample file in sample dir with conversion_rate_pct and optional non_cpg_methylation_pct.
sidecar_filename.title: Sidecar Filename

source.description: auto: use sidecar when present, else deamination proxy.
source.title: Source

BisulfiteConversionConfig.title: BisulfiteConversionConfig

CoreGuardrailsConfig.description:
Thresholds for the core WGBS Parabricks guardrails.

Operators set these per deployment in site `actionConfig.alignment_qc.core_guardrails`
or per procedure in a pipeline profile. Values here reproduce the published WGBS
acceptance window so an unset config keeps the QC gate closed rather than silently
passing every sample.

max_deamination_qscore.description: Maximum Parabricks pre-adapter deamination qscore (low is expected in WGBS).
max_deamination_qscore.title: Max Deamination Qscore

max_gc_dropout.description: Maximum Picard GC-bias GC dropout. Raise per deployment for libraries with known GC-rich under-representation (e.g. 6.0) instead of editing code.
max_gc_dropout.title: Max Gc Dropout

min_mean_quality.description: Minimum mean Phred quality averaged across cycles.
min_mean_quality.title: Min Mean Quality

min_oxog_qscore.description: Minimum Parabricks pre-adapter OxoG qscore; lower means more G>T damage risk.
min_oxog_qscore.title: Min Oxog Qscore

min_pf_percent.description: Minimum percentage of reads passing Illumina PF filtering.
min_pf_percent.title: Min Pf Percent

min_q30_percent.description: Minimum percentage of PF bases at Q30 or better (85 strict, 80 relaxed).
min_q30_percent.title: Min Q30 Percent

min_quality_post20.description: Minimum per-cycle quality after cycle 20 (late-cycle degradation).
min_quality_post20.title: Min Quality Post20

CoreGuardrailsConfig.title: CoreGuardrailsConfig

CycleScreeningConfig.description: Per-cycle read-end screening for remediation dispositions.

fallback_trim_front.description: Trim bases from read starts when remediate_without_cycles fires.
fallback_trim_front.title: Fallback Trim Front

fallback_trim_tail.description: Trim bases from read tails when remediate_without_cycles fires.
fallback_trim_tail.title: Fallback Trim Tail

read_length.description: Override read length; default inferred as max_cycle // 2.
read_length.title: Read Length

remediate_without_cycles.description: When true and mean_quality_by_cycle is absent, allow REALIGN_TRIM from conversion/mapped-rate failure signals (pangenome_wgbs). Operator-set per site/profile actionConfig.alignment_qc.cycle_screening.
remediate_without_cycles.title: Remediate Without Cycles

FragmentomicsConfig.description: Optional cfDNA / fragment-length QC derived from insert-size histograms.

long_fragment_min_bp.description: Fragments at or above this size are 'long'.
long_fragment_min_bp.title: Long Fragment Min Bp

max_short_fragment_fraction.description: Fail cfDNA guardrail when short-fragment fraction exceeds this.
max_short_fragment_fraction.title: Max Short Fragment Fraction

profile.description: Guardrail profile: cfdna adds nucleosome/short-fragment checks; wgbs metrics only.
profile.title: Profile

short_fragment_max_bp.description: Fragments at or below this size are 'short'.
short_fragment_max_bp.title: Short Fragment Max Bp

OptionalGuardrailsConfig.description: Config-gated guardrails beyond core WGBS Parabricks checks.

duplication_rate_max.description: When set, fail when summary_stats.duplication_rate exceeds this.
duplication_rate_max.title: Duplication Rate Max

min_pf_reads.description: When set, fail when quality_yield.pf_reads is below this.
min_pf_reads.title: Min Pf Reads

description: Config for alignment QC step: sample paths and output directory.

alignment_guardrails.description: Alignment-layer guardrails (mapping rate, GC uniformity, flagstat pairing).

auto_profile_from_analyte.description: When true, enable fragmentomics profile cfdna if step_config.validation.regulatory.primary_analyte is cfdna.
auto_profile_from_analyte.title: Auto Profile From Analyte

bisulfite_conversion.description: Optional bisulfite conversion rate QC from per-sample sidecar files.

core_guardrails.description: Thresholds for the core WGBS guardrails (PF, Q30, GC/AT dropout, insert size, artifact qscores). Unset uses the published acceptance window.

cycle_screening.description: Read 2 start cycle screening for remediation dispositions.

fragmentomics.description: Optional fragment-length / cfDNA metrics from insert-size histogram.

genome_fasta.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA (e.g. hg38.fa). This is the project's shared genome reference; downstream consumers such as the MethylEnricher CIS-BP promoter scan default to this value.
genome_fasta.title: Genome Fasta

optional_guardrails.description: Additional guardrails (duplication rate, min PF reads). Opt in via step_config.

output_dir.description: Output directory; one JSON per sample as {output_dir}/{basename}.json
output_dir.title: Output Dir

validate_schema.description: Whether to validate each sample JSON against schema
validate_schema.title: Validate Schema
